Hey Madelon - you should be able to find the answers to most of your questions on our website here :https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/ :) 

Regarding timing, in Tel Aviv I think the common response time (to just get a date for the next stage) is around 3 months, but it can be longer. Others might be able to share their experiences. 

Regarding whether the Israeli can submit a request to visit as a tourst after submitting the partner visa application, my understanding is that this is not possible, as it is not permitted to have two different visa applications open at once. Also, even if it were permitted, I think it would likely be declined as PIBA would assess that there is a high risk for you to settle in Israel (given you have applied for a partner visa). However your partner can definitely go visit you, but just be aware that PIBA does not process applications while the Israeli is abroad, so if he is away for a long time, it could delay things.
